description:
Get the fact revision ledger of a filing's statement

Return the immutable fact revision events one filing's statement recorded against the earlier filing it revised. The statement is named by company, accession, statement type, fiscal year and fiscal period, and by statement_date when the filing reports two OTHER periods in the year. An unknown filing or statement identity is answered with 404 `EDGAR_STATEMENTS_NOT_FOUND`.

accession_id.description: EDGAR accession ID of the filing that reported the statement (e.g., 0000320193-24-000123).

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal period code (e.g., FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4).

statement_date.description: End date of the statement's period (YYYY-MM-DD). Needed only when the filing reports more than one statement for the fiscal year and period: a fiscal year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization is reported as two OTHER periods. Without it such a request answers 409 `EDGAR_STATEMENT_AMBIGUOUS`, listing the dates in `details.available_statement_dates`.

name: edgar_companies_filings_statements_fact_revisions
